text:
sarah: Quick in-thread roundup from the failover postmortem. We need owners, tiny test plans, and firm dates so the next rehearsal isn't a fire drill. Keep replies short.

mike: I'll take routing weight smoothing + rollback automation. Plan: implement staged cutover with fast rollback hook and a simulated traffic replay. Target: 1880070000.

olivia: I'll own cross-region backup verification. I'll run a 30-day checksum sweep and a sample eu->staging restore. Target: 1880045000. Ticket INF-8333 when I create it.

zach: I'll update the restore runbook with choreography (who calls who), add the KMS/network preflight, and run the dry-run. Due: 1880090000.

sarah: Please add short test acceptance criteria for each item so we can mark them done in the remediation board.

mike: Acceptance for routing: synthetic replay shows <10% p95 uplift at each stage; automated rollback fires on p95>650ms or 5xx>0.8% for 3m. I'll add a small harness.

olivia: Backup acceptance: checksum pass across last 30 snapshots, one successful sandbox restore, and unit test that verifies replication logs contain no >5m gaps.

zach: Runbook checklist snippet I'll add:```
restore-runbook-v2 checklist:
1) Confirm snapshot ID and region mapping
2) Run KMS & peering preflight
3) Restore DB to sandbox
4) Run hash diffs and sample inference smoke tests
5) Rollback / teardown and collect logs
```

sarah: Ops, calendar placeholder for a 2hr rehearsal and enable tracing retention around the event.

ops-bot: Created calendar event: "DR rehearsal 1" at 1880160000. Tracing retention set to 7 days for the window.

sre-bot: Follow-up items logged: followup/1880001234-routing-smoothing (owner: mike, due: 1880070000), followup/1880001234-backup-verify (owner: olivia, due: 1880045000), followup/1880001234-runbook-dryrun (owner: zach, due: 1880090000).

mike: Also observed recurring pattern: publish queue growth ~deploy windows then replication lag spikes. I'll add an alert: publish_queue_depth > 450 for 2m and a dashboard panel correlating queue depth with replication_lag and deploy annotations. Target for dashboard: 1880030000.

olivia: Will link backup ticket INF-8333 to the dashboard once created. I'll paste checksum results to the ticket.

sarah: One more policy ask: add a staged cutover config to runbook with cooldowns so we avoid "big bang" switches. Example:```
cutover:
  stages: [10,25,50,75,100]
  cooldown_secs: 120
  rollback_conditions:
    - p95_latency_ms > 650
    - error_rate_5xx_pct > 0.8
```

zach: I'll tag all runbooks with `dr-rehearsal-2026` and record the dry-run video to the remediation board for product/support.

sarah: Ops, can you also generate a 90d incident trend for regional failover alerts and paste the summary link? I want frequency + overlap with deploys.

ops-bot: Generating 90d trend... done. Link: https://console.internal/redwood/reports/failover-90d (SSO required). Summary: 8 incidents in 90d, 5 correlated with deploys, 3 with replication lag.

sarah: Thanks. Action summary in-thread:
- routing smoothing & rollback automation: mike -> 1880070000
- backup verification + sandbox restore: olivia -> 1880045000 (INF-8333)
- restore runbook edits + dry-run: zach -> 1880090000
- dashboard for queue vs replication lag: mike/olivia -> 1880030000
- rehearsal calendar + tracing retention: ops-bot -> 1880160000

mike: I'll PR the orchestrator change and paste link when ready.

olivia: INF-8333 created: https://jira.internal/INF-8333 assigned to @olivia.

sarah: Treat these as committed unless someone flags here. We'll track progress on the remediation board and review in the next incident-owners sync. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
